title: Model rocket
description: Estes C6 model rocket: nose cone, body tube, motor mount, fins. Live Barrowman stability.

params.name: body_length
params.label: Body length
params.help: Body tube length; the nose adds to it. Longer is more stable.

params.name: body_diameter
params.label: Body diameter
params.help: Outside diameter of the body tube. Wider adds drag and weight.

params.name: nose_length
params.label: Nose length
params.help: A longer nose is slimmer and slips through the air more easily.

params.name: nose_shape
params.label: Nose shape
params.help: Ogive: rounded shoulders, low drag. Cone: straight sides.

params.name: fin_count
params.label: Fin count
params.help: Fins, evenly spaced round the tail. More fins, more stability.

params.name: fin_root
params.label: Fin root chord
params.help: Fin length along the body tube.

params.name: fin_tip
params.label: Fin tip chord
params.help: Fin length at its outer edge.

params.name: fin_span
params.label: Fin span
params.help: How far each fin sticks out. Bigger fins pull the CP back: more stable.

params.name: fin_sweep
params.label: Fin sweep
params.help: How far back the tip's leading edge sits from the root's.
